\par\medskip\noindent\textit{Panel B. Data checks}\par\smallskip
\noindent\begin{tabularx}{\linewidth}{@{}>{\raggedright\arraybackslash}p{0.26\linewidth}>{\raggedright\arraybackslash}X@{}}
\toprule
Item & Finding \\
\midrule
Release & GCoM -- MyCovenant, 7th Release -- January 2026 (DOI 10.2905/JRC.MDWNXYR); 9,856 inventories in action plans and 3,399 in monitoring reports \\
Harmonisation & The 2021 steps (emission factors outside $\pm$50\% of reference values replaced, missing emissions derived from activity data, outliers removed; \citealp{kona2021global}) are not described in the release documentation; 55.5\% of the 4,471 inventories with the same identifier have identical energy-sector values in both releases \\
Same inventories in both analysis samples & 7,011 inventories: identical energy-sector values 58.4\%, totals 41.3\%, sector sets 82.2\%, population 97.4\%; 999 lack the waste reported in 2021, so six-sector donors fall from 774 to 307 (Table~S25) \\
One inventory per signatory, type and year & 11,776 inventories; 1,362 keys had several entries, 635 with different totals; the latest entry is kept \\
Match with the 2021 dataset & 7,364 of the 8,045 inventories of 2021 found by signatory, type and year \\
Re-entered inventories & 1,014 inventories with waste in 2021 appear without waste (Andaluc\'ia 441, Catalonia 400) \\
NUTS codes & Release codes follow NUTS 2021 (all valid; 95.3\% also valid in NUTS 2016); NUTS 2016 is used throughout \\
Covariates & 2021 ancillary values for 2021 signatories (9,764 analysis inventories); for 948 inventories of new signatories, LAU 2018 population and area, NUTS3 GDP per capita from the 2021 table and NUTS3 heating degree days \\
Validation on 2021 signatories & NUTS3 agreement 96.8\%; median absolute difference 1.2\% for density and 3.3\% for heating degree days \\
Exclusions & Joint plans of several municipalities (160 inventories); inventories outside 0.01--100~t per capita (3): Lingewaard 1990 BEI (36,721~t per capita; total 45,879 times its 2021 value), \"Orebro 2000 BEI (population 124, against 140,000 in 2021) and Sant'Omobono Terme 2015 MEI (0.0075~t per capita, as in 2021). The same rule removes two 2021 inventories (Table~S23, second column) \\
\bottomrule
\end{tabularx}
\par\smallskip\noindent\begin{minipage}{\linewidth}\footnotesize Notes: Reproduced: share of 2021 sector values equal to the mapped 7th-release sum within 0.01\%. Agriculture and non-allocated buildings are assigned to the residential sector because this reproduces the 2021 values; residential buildings alone reproduce 3,032 of the 4,351. Waste: in 837 inventories the 7th-release value is 0.885 times the 2021 value. Remaining differences mostly combine identical activity with different emissions, consistent with the emission-factor corrections and gap filling of the 2021 harmonisation \citep{kona2021global}. Sectors with zero reported emissions are treated as not reported (426 entries).\end{minipage}
